statement.zh: 印度河文字因缺乏双语文本等原因，在学界仍无普遍接受的破译——此为研究现况，非「永不可破」断言。
statement.en: Indus script remains without a generally accepted decipherment (no bilingual texts) — research status, not permanent undecipherability.

editorial.notes: Derived only from civ MD + registered sources. No new archaeological inventions.
